corrections.old: Anterior and superior: temporal branches of CN VII. Posterior: posterior auricular branch of CN VII
corrections.new: Temporal and posterior auricular branches of CN VII (anterior and superior mainly temporal, posterior mainly posterior auricular)
corrections.ref: Netter Table 2.4 (p219): auricularis anterior/posterior/superior all "Posterior auricular and temporal branches of facial nerve"; consistency with posterior-auricular-nerve
corrections.reason: Muscle card assigned anterior/superior to temporal only; Netter lists both branches for all three and the posterior-auricular-nerve card claims anterior and superior too

corrections.old: Sublingual branch of lingual artery and submental branch of facial artery
corrections.new: Sublingual branch of lingual artery and submental branch of facial artery; mylohyoid branch of inferior alveolar artery
corrections.ref: Netter Plates 25, 69 (mylohyoid branch of inferior alveolar artery); consistency with inferior-alveolar-artery Supplies
corrections.reason: inferior-alveolar-artery card lists mylohyoid in Supplies but the muscle card omitted its mylohyoid branch

notes: All 79 muscle cards cross-checked against nerve Supplies, artery Supplies and bone Attachments; innervation and blood supply agree with Netter Tables 2.4-2.9 and back Tables for neck extensors. Only two cross-card gaps found.
